subject: Novamed: proposal for VPC packaging — ops-credit swap + latency warranty

Cc: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novamed VPC commercial: platform fee / credits ask

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the dedicated VPC path looks like the right fit for our imaging pipeline. Procurement asked me to surface two commercial asks before we escalate to legal:

1) Platform fee amortization / ops-credit swap
   - Given our expected steady-state usage and 24-month horizon, we'd prefer to reduce the up-front platform fee and instead take a larger ops-credit bucket (applied to per-token consumption and support engineering hours). Can you run a swap scenario (platform fee reduction in exchange for X ops credits)?

2) Latency warranty for critical endpoints
   - For a subset of inference traffic (study ingestion + urgent reads), we need a 24/7 latency warranty (99th percentile target). If you can provide a service-credit-backed warranty for that SLA, we can commit earlier.

I've attached a simple SOW and a short monthly usage forecast so you can model numbers. Also cc'd procurement — they'll review pricing once we have a concrete proposal.

If possible, can you send a counter-proposal this week? We're trying to close commercial terms by the end of next week.

Best,
Tom
Head of Platform Engineering
Novamed

Attachments: SOW_Novamed_v1.pdf (SOW summary), novamed_monthly_profile.csv (usage profile)
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Novamed VPC commercial: platform fee / credits ask

Tom — thanks for the clear ask and the usage file. High level response below; I attached a brief ops-credit table and a draft latency warranty clause for reference.

Summary proposal (options):
- Option A (Balanced): 12-month commit, platform fee reduced 10% year 1, +25% ops-credit bucket applied to tokens + 40 engineering hours / quarter of prioritized SRE support.
- Option B (Aggressive swap): 18-month commit, platform fee reduced 25%, +50% ops-credit bucket, includes 1 annual onsite review and 80 engineering hours / quarter.

Latency warranty (targeted endpoints):
- We can offer a 99th percentile latency warranty for named critical routes. Proposed SLA: 99th pct < 350ms for the three critical endpoints during business-P1 window; for 24/7 warranty we can include a credit ladder (detailed in the attached doc).

We also propose a P1 response commitment of 1 hour (Gold support add-on) — this is an add-on to either option and priced separately in the ops-credit table.

Next steps: if you like Option B we can prepare a redlineable SOW and draft DocuSign for signature. If you prefer Option A, we can provide a finalized commercial term sheet and schedule an internal review.

Link to tentative DocuSign (preview): https://www.docusign.com/preview/ABCDEF123456789

Thanks — I'll coordinate internally on the latency warranty wording and loop in the legal SOW writer.

—Chloe

Subject: Fwd: Novamed VPC commercial: ops-credit swap — internal sizing / ask

Folks — forwarding Novamed's ask and my response. They want platform-fee relief in exchange for ops credits and an SLA warranty on a subset of traffic. Quick internal notes and asks:

- Pricing sensitivity: Novamed is mid-market but in regulated health; they prioritize latency for emergent reads. They will likely push for Option B if we can add the 24/7 warranty and 1-hour P1.
- Proposed concession window: we should cap the aggressive swap to an 18-month committed term and an annualized minimum commit to avoid downside exposure.
- Technical feasibility: Ben — can we commit to the 99th pct < 350ms across their named endpoints with current routing + cache config? If not, what ops hours estimate to reach it reliably?
- Legal / SOW wording: Marissa / Lauren — please craft a service-credit ladder tied to the named endpoints (we should avoid open-ended full-scale credits for general platform). Proposed start: credit = 5% of monthly platform fee per missed SLA window, escalates with repeat misses.

Suggested commercial compromise (my recommendation):
- Offer Option B but with a capped ops-credit escrow (not unlimited). Escrow release tied to monthly usage & three-month review. Platform fee reduction 20% (slightly less than their ask) + +40% ops-credit bucket. Gold support (1-hour P1) as paid add-on drawn from ops-credit; any overrun billed at T&M.

Please reply with quick thumbs up / red flags. I want to get a cleaner counter to Tom by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Chloe

Chloe — appreciate the quick turnaround and the detailed options. Procurement reviewed Option B and asked for two clarifications before we proceed to signatures:

1) SLA specifics and penalties
   - Can we tighten the 24/7 named-endpoint SLA to 99th pct < 300ms and have the credit ladder start at 7% for the first miss, 12% for second within 90 days? We can accept a short remediation period but we need teeth in the commitment.

2) Ops-credit escrow mechanics
   - Novamed prefers the ops-credit escrow to be accessible for both token consumption and prioritized SRE time. If ops-credit is exhausted, we'd like an option to pre-purchase an additional block at a fixed rate for the remainder of the term.

Assuming those two clarifications are acceptable, procurement is ready to move to a redline. We also need a short PO-intent (one-pager) to start internal approvals — I've attached Novamed_PO_intent.pdf.

A few quick notes: we are aligned on the 18-month commitment and the onsite review — those are helpful. The tighter SLA is important for our clinicians.

Thanks — standing by for the updated draft and proposed DocuSign.

Best,
Tom
Head of Platform Engineering
Novamed
